name: Share Housing and Essential Needs (HEN)
description: Rental assistance and crisis management for households experiencing homelessness who have temporary disability-related HEN eligibility.
who_qualifies: Households found eligible for Housing and Essential Needs by Washington DSHS and referred through the Housing Solutions Center.
application_method: Call the Housing Solutions Center at 360-695-9677 to ask about eligibility and coordinated entry.
public_notes: Program entry requires a Housing Solutions Center referral; assistance depends on eligibility and current capacity.

name: St. Vincent de Paul Vancouver Rent Assistance
description: Limited rent assistance for households within the Vancouver conference service boundary.
who_qualifies: Applicant must be within the service boundary and named on the lease; additional limits are published on the provider website.
application_method: Call 360-694-5388 at the next application time posted by the provider. This is a call-in-only program.
public_notes: Funds are limited and assistance is not guaranteed. Do not visit the office to apply for rent or utility assistance.

name: St. Vincent de Paul at St. John Rent and Utility Assistance
description: Rent or utility payment assistance when funds are available for households in central and north Clark County service areas.
who_qualifies: Serves Brush Prairie, north Orchards, north Hazel Dell, Salmon Creek, Hockinson, and nearby central Clark County areas.
application_method: Call 360-573-7199 during the provider's posted hours to ask whether funds are available.
public_notes: Service area and funding availability must be confirmed with the provider before applying.

name: Interfaith Treasure House Rent and Utility Assistance
description: Limited rent and utility assistance for eligible households in east Clark County.
who_qualifies: Primarily serves residents east of 164th Avenue through the Skamania County line, including Camas and Washougal.
application_method: Call the Interfaith Treasure House office at 360-834-4181 to ask whether assistance is currently available.
public_notes: Funding and geographic eligibility can change; call before visiting or submitting documents.

name: Salvation Army Washougal Rent and Utility Assistance
description: Emergency rent and utility assistance for residents of Camas and Washougal when funding is available.
who_qualifies: Residents of the Camas and Washougal service area; the provider confirms current requirements.
application_method: Call 360-835-3171 to confirm current funding, service-area eligibility, and application steps.
source_type: Official provider and city resource guide
public_notes: Assistance is limited and availability can change; contact the local corps before traveling.
